_note: hand-authored 1940s military-depth sites (no third-party licence); generated by tools/make_military_depth_1940.py. Positions are real WGS84 camp / depot / locality coordinates cited per record; the huts, magazines, lorries, horses and flatcars are placed by seed around that point. The scenery is procedural low-poly toon from GroundKit primitives; no third-party geometry, imagery or data file was copied.
